---
title: "Testing"
description: "Scan a synthetic document with a test credential to get a known outcome."
---

Use a test credential with the documents below. Each one returns the outcome shown when you open it. Print a barcode at 100% or show it on a second screen; the MRZ images are set in OCR-B so the camera can read them.

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Driver's license">
    <AccordionGroup>
      <Accordion title="Accept">
        <Frame caption="T90000001">
          <img src="/images/testing/drivers_license-accept.png" alt="Accept" />
        </Frame>
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_ACCEPT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="dldv" type="completed" />
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion title="Expired">
        <Frame caption="T90000002">

        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_EXPIRED" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="false" />
      </Accordion>

  <Tab title="Passport book">
    <AccordionGroup>
      <Accordion title="Accept">
        <Frame caption="T90000016">
          <img src="/images/testing/passport_book-accept.png" alt="Accept" />
        </Frame>
        ```text
        P<USATEST<<ACCEPT<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
        T900000169USA9006061M3012109<<<<<<<<<<<<<<06
        ```
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_ACCEPT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion title="Expired">
        <Frame caption="T90000017">
          <img src="/images/testing/passport_book-expired.png" alt="Expired" />
        </Frame>
        ```text
        P<USATEST<<EXPIRED<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
        T900000170USA9006061M2001012<<<<<<<<<<<<<<08
        ```
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_REJECT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_EXPIRED" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="false" />
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion title="Underage">
        <Frame caption="T90000018">
          <img src="/images/testing/passport_book-underage.png" alt="Underage" />
        </Frame>
        ```text
        P<USATEST<<UNDERAGE<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
        T900000181USA1506060M3012109<<<<<<<<<<<<<<00
        ```
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_REJECT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_REAL" />
        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_NOT_OF_AGE" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="false" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion title="Invalid checksum">
        <Frame caption="T90000019">
          <img src="/images/testing/passport_book-invalid_checksum.png" alt="Invalid checksum" />
        </Frame>
        ```text
        P<USATEST<<INVALID<CHECKSUM<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
        T900000192USA9006061M3012109<<<<<<<<<<<<<<01
        ```
        <ResponseField name="verification.decision" type="DECISION_REJECT" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.integrity" type="INTEGRITY_FAKE" />
        <ResponseField name="reason" type="REASON_BARCODE_VALIDATION_FAILED" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.of_age" type="true" />
        <ResponseField name="verification.not_expired" type="true" />
      </Accordion>
    </AccordionGroup>
  </Tab>
